09 · Iconography

Sports & activities

FitMeet covers 20+ sports. Each category has a simple, linear icon and an associated color for quick recognition on the map and in lists.

🏃Running
🚴Cycling
🥾Hiking
🏋️Fitness

🏊Swimming
🧘Yoga
🧗Climbing
🛹Skating
⛷️Skiing

Mapping on the map

On the map, each active pin is shown as a solid circle in the sport's color, with the icon centered inside. The user's own events are highlighted with a brighter halo effect (Signal Green).
